records.title: Uploaded .mov videos fail AI indexing with generic processing error
records.evidence: Two .mov uploads appeared in AI Indexing and failed with the same generic processing error. Reported files: YouTube Final.mov, 153.5 MB; TikTok 111meg copy.mov, 56.6 MB.

records.title: Cannot bulk-select files/videos and trigger indexing
records.status: historical workflow report; current retest needed
records.evidence: No clear multi-select action was available to index or re-index a selected group of files or videos.
